test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I have lost my school diary; I can’t find it __nowhere__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**anywhere**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, '**anywhere**' should be used instead of '**nowhere**'.
 
• It means **'in, at or to any place.' **(कहीं भी, कहीं पर भी)
 
 
• *Example: I can’t find my keys **anywhere**.*
 
 
 
• The first clause of the given sentence clearly states that the school diary is lost. Hence, it couldn't be found at any place.
 
• A negative word i.e.** 'not'** has already been used in the sentence. Thus, we cannot use another negative word '**nowhere**'.
 
• Hence, '**anywhere**' should be used.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I have lost my school diary; I can't find it **anywhere**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Wherever**: in or to any place. [जहाँ कहीं (किसी भी स्‍थान में या पर)]
 
• **Everywhere**: in or to every place. (सब जगह, सर्वत्र)
 
• **Somewhere**: at, in, or to a place that you do not know or do not mention by name. [स्थान पर जो आपको नहीं मालूम या जिसका नाम आप नहीं बताते; कहीं]
